"Between " + clock(d.eta.window_from) + " and " + clock(d.eta.window_to) : "By " + clock(d.eta.window_to)); } } } run.classList.remove("on"); if (d.run) { if (!d.show_rider) { if (d.run.stops_before > 0) { run.textContent = "You are stop " + d.run.stop_no + " of " + d.run.stops_total + ". The live map turns on when you are next."; run.classList.add("on"); } } } if (d.run) { if (d.show_rider) { if (d.run.stops_total > 1) { $("#sa_role").textContent = "Stop " + d.run.stop_no + " of " + d.run.stops_total + " on this run"; } } } code.classList.toggle("on", !!d.show_code); if (d.vehicle) { if (!d.run || d.run.stops_total == 1) { $("#sa_role").textContent = d.vehicle; } } } var missed = 0, pollTimer = null; function poll() { fetch(POS_URL, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) { missed = 0; $("#sa_live").textContent = "live"; apply(d); schedule(d.next_poll_seconds || 20); }).catch(function () { missed += 1; if (missed > 2) { $("#sa_live").textContent = "reconnecting…"; } schedule(15); }); } function schedule(s) { if (STATE === "delivered") { return; } clearTimeout(pollTimer); pollTimer = setTimeout(poll, Math.max(5, Math.min(60, s)) * 1000); } if (window.SaTrackMap) { freeMap = SaTrackMap.start({ container: "sa_map", style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty", picture: "/sales_automation_delivery/static/src/img/rider-top.png", pictureHeight: 256, drawnHeight: 52, decode: decode, onShown: function () { $("#sa_nomap").style.display = "none"; }, onFail: function () { freeMap = null; if (lastPayload) { apply(lastPayload); } }, }); } apply(INIT); setInterval(fresh, 1000); if (STATE !== "delivered") { schedule(INIT.next_poll_seconds || 10); }
